description: The official 2023 publisher abstract documents a daily-delivery maximisation model in Bari old town. Trucks serve zone hubs and robots complete narrow-street deliveries. PTV Vissim tests examine different robot speeds. The publisher header names Krendeleva, Rotunno, Ukovich and Fanti; native metadata lists Fanti only. The later 2025 SUMO paper shares a related delivery formulation but different simulator and author list. Exact model or data equivalence is unknown, so this source-defined model remains distinct. Public access and the deposit document licence do not establish executable access, software reuse rights or operating costs. Coverage remains bounded to the named experiments, with other geographic and temporal fields unknown. Related project resources may overlap; common project membership does not establish identical simulation inputs or results.
